    var ga = new GlideAjax('OIGOktaAPIQueryAjax');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getOktaApplications');
    ga.getXMLAnswer(getResponse);

    function getResponse(response) {
        var appsArray = JSON.parse(response);
        for (var i = 0; i < appsArray.length; i++) {
            var app = appsArray[i];
            g_form.addOption('connected_application', app.value, app.label);
        }
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-30 20:52:25</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>e54bf1df971e4710326630fce053af92</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Get All Applications</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Okta Workflows" source="x_1647345_okta_w_0">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Okta Workflows">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_e54bf1df971e4710326630fce053af92</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-30 20:52:25</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1647345_okta_w_0.ServiceAccountCreationUtilitiesAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>IAM Service Account Creation Utilities (AJAX)</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ServiceAccountCreationUtilitiesAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ServiceAccountCreationUtilitiesAjax = Class.create();
ServiceAccountCreationUtilitiesAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    getUserGroups: function() {
        var userSysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_user_id'); // Get user ID from client
        if (!userSysId) {
            return {
                error: 'User ID is required'
            };
        }

        var groups = [];
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
        gr.addQuery('user', userSysId);
        gr.query();

        while (gr.next()) {
            var group = gr.group; // Get the group's sys_id
            var groupName = group.name; //Get the group's name
            groups.push({
                id: group.sys_id.toString(),
                name: groupName.toString()
            });
        }
        return JSON.stringify({
            groups: groups
        }); // Returns an object
    },
    type: 'ServiceAccountCreationUtilitiesAjax'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-10 07:04:32</sys_created_on><sys_id>574013ec97d34710326630fce053af7d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ServiceAccountCreationUtilitiesAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Okta Workflows" source="x_1647345_okta_w_0">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Okta Workflows">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_574013ec97d34710326630fce053af7d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-10 07:04:32</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="New Service Account Request">b33b31df971e4710326630fce053af5c</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:944b71df971e4710326630fce053af5a</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Get Groups</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }
    g_form.clearOptions('team');
    g_form.addOption('team', '', '--None--');
    var ga = new GlideAjax('x_1647345_okta_w_0.ServiceAccountCreationUtilitiesAjax'); //Call the script include
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getUserGroups');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_user_id', newValue); // Pass the user ID
    ga.getXML(function(response) {
        var result = response.responseXML.documentElement.getAttribute("answer");
        var data = JSON.parse(result);

        if (data.groups.length > 0) {
            for (var i = 0; i < data.groups.length; i++) {
                var group = data.groups[i];
                g_form.addOption('team', group.name, group.name);
            }
        } else {
            g_form.showFieldMsg('team', "The user doesn't have any assigned groups in ServiceNow.");
        }
        g_form.addOption('team', 'not_listed', 'Group Not Listed - Provide Team Name Below Change');
    });

    //Type appropriate comment here, and begin script below

}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-30 20:52:25</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>294bf1df971e4710326630fce053afcc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Get Groups</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Okta Workflows" source="x_1647345_okta_w_0">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Okta Workflows">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_294bf1df971e4710326630fce053afcc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-10 07:05:02</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
